Subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path — Acme Corp

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on procurement and signatory path: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned procurement typically requires a PO and runs on a 30–45 day cadence for new vendors. Can you confirm whether Acme would process via PO or if you have a company card on file for smaller pilots?

2) Marketplace: You said there was interest in using AWS Marketplace for procurement (for speed). Can you confirm who owns Marketplace enablement and whether that would reduce the approval timeline?

3) Budget owner / signatory: We heard that Tom (VP Eng) is the economic buyer and Sarah Kim in Finance is the procurement sponsor. Please confirm names and email for the signatory (legal/ops) so we can route the commercial paperwork correctly.

4) Compliance checklist: Per your ask, attaching a short SOC2 snapshot and a draft SOW / pricing worksheet for internal review. If there are any additional security evidence items you need (ISO, penetration test reports), flag them and we'll prioritize.

Proposed next steps: 
- If PO is required: we'll send a preliminary SOW + commercial term sheet for your procurement team to intake.
- If Marketplace is preferred: we'll provide the pricing card and marketplace SKU for your procurement enablement team.

Would you be available for a 30-min procurement touchpoint next week (Tue/Wed) with Tom and Sarah?

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path — Acme Corp

Marissa —

Great demo today, thanks. Quick answers inline: 

1) Procurement path: For pilot purchases under $50k we usually take a PO; anything under $10k often goes on a corporate card. For vendor onboarding it's typically PO + basic vendor form. Expect ~30 days for first PO (vendor creation + legal review).

2) Marketplace: We do prefer AWS Marketplace where possible — it shortens procurement and payment handling. Marketplace enablement is handled by our Cloud Procurement team (I've cc'd Sarah who can connect us to that team).

3) Budget owner / signatory: Confirmed — Tom Liang (tom.liang@acme.com) is the economic buyer. Sarah Kim (sarah.kim@acme.com) is the finance sponsor and handles vendor enablement. Final signatory on Master Services Agreements is typically our Head of Legal, Michael Torres (michael.torres@acme.com) — he will be engaged for the final contract.

4) Compliance: SOC2 snapshot looks fine as a starting point. We may ask for a short questionnaire and an SOC2 bridge letter if we move to PO.

I'm happy to do a 30-min procurement call next Tue 3/31 11am PT. Works for you?

Best,
Jane
Jane Foster | Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
jane.foster@acme.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-26T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement readiness & commercial path — Acme Corp

Marissa — forwarding Jane's note. Notes / ask from a commercial perspective: 

- PO path is likely (30 days). We should prepare a clean SOW + standard T&Cs that can be sent to Sarah for vendor intake. I attached the SOW draft and a pricing worksheet — please update the SKU/pricing rows for a 3-month pilot (expected token volumes ~100M tokens/month per their demo).

- Marketplace option could speed things up; prospect prefers AWS Marketplace but that requires an enablement lead on their side. If they go marketplace, pricing may need to convert to an AMI/SKU — coordinate with product ops.

- Budget owner mapping: Tom = economic buyer (technical), Sarah = finance sponsor (procurement enablement), Michael Torres = legal signatory. For internal approvals we should route as: AE -> Solutions (for technical acceptance) -> Finance (Sarah) -> Legal (Michael) -> Exec sign-off if >$250k TCV.

Action items: 
1) Marissa: update SOW/pricing to reflect pilot term and include a PO invoicing option and Marketplace SKU fallback.
2) Aditya: can you confirm if we have an existing Marketplace SKU for the recommended model families? If not, what's the timeline to create one?
3) Laura: prep a short one-page vendor intake packet (SOC2 + contact list + pricing) for Sarah.

I'll join the procurement call next Tue if the timings line up.

-Vivek
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
